input.prompt:
Assign 5 people Ada, Boris, Cleo, Dan, Eva to 5 slots S1, S2, S3, S4, S5 (one person per slot). Preference scores:
Ada: S1=6, S2=2, S3=7, S4=9, S5=3
Boris: S1=6, S2=6, S3=9, S4=7, S5=7
Cleo: S1=6, S2=7, S3=8, S4=5, S5=10
Dan: S1=6, S2=1, S3=10, S4=1, S5=1
Eva: S1=10, S2=7, S3=8, S4=8, S5=7
Fixed: Ada must take S1. Forbidden: Boris cannot take S3; Dan cannot take S2. Maximize the total preference score.

Output a single JSON object of the form {"assignment": {"<person>": "<slot>", ...}} mapping every person to a slot. Output a single JSON object and nothing else (no code fences, no explanation).

Two machines M0 and M1 process jobs A, B, C, D, E. Durations: A=3, B=5, C=6, D=6, E=2. Precedence (must finish before next starts): A before C, B before C, C before D. Machine eligibility: A on [0, 1], B on [0, 1], C on [0, 1], D on [0, 1], E on [1]. Minimize the makespan (time the last job finishes). Time starts at 0.

Output a single JSON object of the form {"machine": {"A": 0, ...}, "start": {"A": 0, ...}} with the chosen machine (0 or 1) and integer start time of every job. Output a single JSON object and nothing else (no code fences, no explanation).

Two machines M0 and M1 process jobs A, B, C, D, E, F. Durations: A=6, B=4, C=6, D=6, E=3, F=6. Precedence (must finish before next starts): A before D, B before D, C before E, D before F, E before F. Machine eligibility: A on [0, 1], B on [0], C on [0, 1], D on [0, 1], E on [0, 1], F on [0, 1]. Minimize the makespan (time the last job finishes). Time starts at 0.

Output a single JSON object of the form {"machine": {"A": 0, ...}, "start": {"A": 0, ...}} with the chosen machine (0 or 1) and integer start time of every job. Output a single JSON object and nothing else (no code fences, no explanation).

Choose a subset of projects to maximize total value. Projects:
P0: cost=3, value=8
P1: cost=3, value=4
P2: cost=3, value=7
P3: cost=6, value=9
P4: cost=3, value=3
P5: cost=4, value=9
Budget (total cost at most 12). Exclusions (never both): P0+P1. Required: none.

Output a single JSON object of the form {"chosen": ["P0", ...]} listing the chosen project ids. Output a single JSON object and nothing else (no code fences, no explanation).
